title: Path on map
description: Ordered paths (a race lap, a route, a track) on the street map with 3D buildings, coloured by an optional value per point, each with a start marker and label.

data.description: Each row is one point of a path, in path order: select it with `order by`. Ungrouped, the rows are one path; grouped, each group's rows are one path.

path.description: The row's position. The first row of each path is its start.

value.description: A number per point (speed, distance, sector…). Each segment takes its start point's colour.

label.description: The path's name, shown at its start.

bounds.description: [west, south, east, north] to frame; null frames the paths.

basemap.description: Which street-map archive to draw under the paths. auto picks the one that covers them.

colorScale.description: sequential: one hue, light to dark with the value. diverging: two hues around the value's midpoint. solid: the accent colour, value ignored.

valueUnit.description: The value's unit, for the legend.

view.description: 2d looks straight down; 3d tilts the camera (pitch 60°) so buildings stand up.

bearing.description: Camera bearing in degrees, clockwise from north.

showBuildings.description: Extrude buildings to their OSM heights.

valid.title: Distance along the lap, from above

error.message: `sped` is not in each row of `points`
